notes: v316 adds a dedicated Cold Glue full-neck-wrap overlap policy. Build Inputs now detects wrap angle from the developed neck-label bottom edge and the effective contact-band circumference, keeps near-full labels on the protected Standard policy, and expands Full Wrap controls when overlap is required. Operators can choose the leading or trailing edge on top, override the calculated overlap in millimeters, enable the final seam wipe, and set seam over-wipe. Generated motion distinguishes first-edge wipe, circumference wipe, overlap-edge crossing, seam wipe, and exit rest; only the designated overlap edge may cross. Standard labels retain opposite-edge clearance protection. The selected edge and overlap are exposed in the preview, program summary, validation, and persisted label recipe.
